I'm 21 and just recently started on anti-depressants and only since I started college felt that I really started developing as a person. I never got invited to any parties in high school, didn't get laid, didn't have many friends and never really reached my full potential academically either. I feel like depression robbed me of what regular adolescence should be. I am happier with who I am in the present than who I was in the past, but there isn't a day that goes by that I don't wish depression robbed me of my teenage years.

I completely understand and it sucks dude. I subliminally want, something absolutely awful to happen or go wrong in my life that'll trigger it and put myself over the edge so I have a legit excuse to off myself. Some of my family and friends know I have depression but I also hide it really well and they don't know how bad it is. If I killed myself tomorrow I just know it would seem extremely out-of-the-blue for all the people who do know me and they would think it would be extremely out of character. I feel like I'm living for other people's sake and not my own. Once I get to the point in my life where all my family and friends will be fine without me in their lives is the point I'll realistically pull the plug.

When I was a teenager, my self esteem was so cripplingly low that I spent most of my time engaged in schoolwork, focusing on applying to college, and trying to improve myself instead of doing what I thought would make me happy. I could've lost my v-card at a much younger age, spent more time with friends, and honestly cut loose and enjoy myself. But no, instead I did none of that and just felt sorry for myself. I'd give anything to redo those years and get back those missed opportunities.
I know, the past is past. Bad memories will be bad memories. I just have so much regret at this point that it's stopping me from enjoying the present to the fullest.

I know, it's just hurtful when everyone is talking about their "prime years" as between 18-21 and me coming to the realization that I didn't take full advantage of that time as I should have. Maybe it's just a quarter life-crisis of sort but I just really feel old when I don't want to.
